criteria.description: S01 接口门槛：Results 表名与首行表头文本、列序、四列数量必须完全一致；违反则全题为零，记录原因。
criteria.evidence: required sheet and exact four-column header are present

criteria.description: S02：Results 每条必需结果的单位必须严格为 AUD million nominal；违反扣3分。
Deduct for Excel error cells outside result cells already assessed
criteria.evidence: error values outside the graded cells: []

criteria.description: 每条必需结果均须有非空文字来源引用；数字或空白不是来源。
三条必需结果按题面顺序从第2行排列，不得缺失、重复或逆序。
criteria.evidence: required row sequence: ['2020 network net capex difference', '2020 non-network net capex difference', '2020 total net capex difference']; expected rows 2, 3, 4

criteria.description: Results 不得包含必需标签之外的业务记录或重复记录；支持工作表不受此结构限制。
Results 数值须显示至少三位小数：General 依存储小数位判断，显式格式依显示小数位判断；数值匹配绝对容差另为0.0005。
criteria.evidence: results not showing at least three decimal places: []

criteria.reason: All cited sources are verifiable in the provided materials. Excel cell references (e.g., 'RFM input'!F7, F61, F115, F169, L7, F282-F287) correspond to actual cells containing the described asset classes, capex values, forecasts, and WACC/inflation parameters. Distribution_handbook.pdf page 27 does contain section 2.4.1 ('Nominal adjustments for difference between actual and forecast net capex in final year') and footnote 20 discussing the nominal vanilla WACC, exactly as cited. No fabricated files, pages, or tables.
criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。

criteria.reason: The candidate contains only source citations and numerical labels. There are no claims of having completed external audits, real-time queries, or independent verification. No unsupported completion statements present.
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。

criteria.reason: The candidate's explanatory text consists solely of asset class names (directly from the input file), group classifications (network/non-network/other), and source references. No new company operating facts are asserted beyond what is contained in the provided input materials.
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。

limitations: 原始明细缺少独立evidence、程序reason或运行字段时保留null；已有裁判reasoning逐字保留。
正项score表示正确程度；负项score表示违规程度，sdk_value与raw原样保留。
rubric_sha256为评分资料绑定值，delivery_rubric_sha256为随包文件校验值；评分条目、权重和容差一致。原始回执未记录运行时输入哈希。
未查到唯一完成时间则finished_at保留null；不以文件修改时间代替。
